{{Quote|Delaya has become a gatheringpoint for Alderaanians who were offworld at the time of the attack. Officially, Leia is here as their leader. She will offer help to the refugees and pay tribute to the memory of the dead.''"<br />"''And unofficially?''"<br />"''She plans to recruit as many refugees as she can for the Rebel cause.|Rezi Soresh and X-7|<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />}}
The '''Mission to Delaya''' was an assignment entrusted to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to recruit [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]]. As her official cover, she was to help the refugees and pay [[Memorial service on Delaya|tribute]] to the ones who perished in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />

She was accompanied by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[X-7|Tobin Elad]], and their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />
